question: 地形抬升（Orographic Lift）对衰减速率的量化影响：当登陆点海拔超过 500 m 时，地形强迫上升气流导致边界层不稳定度增加，使得最大风速衰减速率额外增加 15-25%；典型山区登陆的气旋在越过山脉后的 6 小时内，风速衰减比平原登陆快 3-5 kt/h。

sources.title: Orographic lift - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Orographic lift occurs when an air mass is forced from a low elevation to a higher elevation as it moves over rising terrain. Orography is the study of the topographic relief of mountains.
